what_this_is: The input driven through the shipped CONCORD library ioc-concord. It is one real disagreement between the reviewer's two graders at one head of one merged pull request of cybermonklabs/legion. The positions and the counts below are quoted from our own review record; the raw 0-100 ratings are NOT in our record and are derived by the declared rule in derivation, which is this file's author's and not the record's.

derivation.marked: this mapping is the author's, not our record's; our record holds a verdict word and a finding count per grader and no satisfaction rating and no anchor pair
derivation.anchor: every grader is anchored raw_reject=0, raw_ideal=100, because our record holds no anchor pair
derivation.rule: raw = 100 - 5 * (that grader's findings the candidate leaves unanswered) - 10 if the candidate spends another review round and that grader's own verdict at this head was APPROVE
derivation.unanswered: a finding is answered when the candidate fixes it or records a reason for declining it
